entities.summary: Artak Apitonian is an Armenian diplomat. He was the deputy foreign minister of Armenia in 2018–2021, and Armenian ambassador to Sweden and Finland in 2013–2018. He was the CEO of The FUTURE ARMENIAN Development Foundation in 2022–2024.
